The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported that the Alert Level was lowered to 2 (on a scale of 1-4) at Lewotobi Laki-Laki on 16 September, and the public was warned to stay 4 km away from the center of Laki-Laki.
